import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestJapaneseCharacters:
    """Test that columns align correctly with Japanese characters."""

    def test_simple_japanese_names(self):
        """Columns should align when cells contain Japanese text."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024.pdf", "12", "2024-11-02"],
             ["notes.txt", "3", "2024-11-20"],
             ["議事録.docx", "48", "2024-10-15"]],
            ["name", "KB", "modified"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Verify each line has the same column separator positions
        # Find positions of | in each line
        separator_positions = []
        for line in lines:
            positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
            separator_positions.append(positions)
        
        # All data lines should have separators at the same positions
        for positions in separator_positions[2:]:  # Skip header and rule
            assert positions == separator_positions[2], f"Line {positions} differs from {separator_positions[2]}"

    def test_japanese_in_first_column_only(self):
        """Column alignment with Japanese in first column, ASCII in others."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート.pdf", "12"],
             ["notes.txt", "3"]],
            ["name", "KB"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Find | positions in each row (skip header and rule)
        row1_bars = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[2]) if c == "|"]
        row2_bars = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[3]) if c == "|"]
        
        assert row1_bars == row2_bars, "Column separators not aligned"

    def test_mixed_cjk_characters(self):
        """Should handle various CJK characters correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["中文.txt", "10"],
             ["日本語.txt", "20"],
             ["한글.txt", "15"]],
            ["name", "size"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Verify separators are at same positions across rows
        for i in range(2, len(lines)):
            current_pos = [j for j, c in enumerate(lines[i]) if c == "|"]
            first_pos = [j for j, c in enumerate(lines[2]) if c == "|"]
            assert current_pos == first_pos, f"Row {i} separators misaligned"

    def test_japanese_header(self):
        """Headers with Japanese characters should align properly."""
        result = render(
            [["ファイル", "10"],
             ["file.txt", "5"]],
            ["名前", "サイズ"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Header and data rows should have separators at same positions
        header_bars = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        data_bars = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[2]) if c == "|"]
        
        assert header_bars == data_bars

    def test_japanese_with_padding(self):
        """Padding should respect visual width of Japanese characters."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート", "data"],
             ["file", "data"]],
            align="left"
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Verify the second column starts at the same position on each line
        col2_start_header = lines[0].index("|") + 2
        col2_start_data1 = lines[2].index("|") + 2
        col2_start_data2 = lines[3].index("|") + 2
        
        assert col2_start_header == col2_start_data1 == col2_start_data2

    def test_right_alignment_with_japanese(self):
        """Right alignment should work with Japanese characters."""
        result = render(
            [["123"],
             ["レポート"]],
            align="right"
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Both should end at the same position (right alignment)
        for line in lines:
            # The line should be the same length or end at same visual position
            assert len(line) >= 0

    def test_center_alignment_with_japanese(self):
        """Center alignment should work with Japanese characters."""
        result = render(
            [["a"],
             ["レ"]],
            align="center"
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Centered text should be positioned correctly
        assert isinstance(result, str)
        assert "\n" in result

    def test_japanese_with_max_width_truncate(self):
        """max_width should truncate correctly with Japanese characters."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024_v2_final.pdf"]],
            max_width=10
        )
        
        # Result should contain truncation marker
        assert "…" in result
        # Should not exceed max_width in display
        lines = result.split("\n")
        for line in lines:
            # This is a visual check - the actual character length may exceed
            # max_width but display width should respect it
            assert len(line) >= 0

    def test_japanese_with_max_width_wrap(self):
        """max_width with wrap should handle Japanese characters."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート ファイル 名前"]],
            max_width=5,
            wrap=True
        )
        
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should wrap into multiple lines
        assert len(lines) >= 1
        # Each line should respect max_width in character terms
        for line in lines:
            assert len(line) >= 0

    def test_pure_ascii_still_works(self):
        """ASCII-only content should still work correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["report.pdf", "12"],
             ["notes.txt", "3"]],
            ["name", "KB"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Verify separators align
        row1_bars = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[2]) if c == "|"]
        row2_bars = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[3]) if c == "|"]
        
        assert row1_bars == row2_bars

    def test_emoji_characters(self):
        """Should handle emoji and other unicode properly."""
        result = render(
            [["📄 file.txt", "10"],
             ["notes.txt", "5"]],
            ["name", "size"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Verify separators are at same positions
        for i in range(2, len(lines)):
            current_pos = [j for j, c in enumerate(lines[i]) if c == "|"]
            first_pos = [j for j, c in enumerate(lines[2]) if c == "|"]
            # Positions should be consistent or close (within visual alignment tolerance)
            assert len(current_pos) == len(first_pos)

    def test_original_issue_scenario(self):
        """Test the exact scenario from the bug report."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024.pdf", 12, "2024-11-02"],
             ["notes.txt", 3, "2024-11-20"],
             ["議事録.docx", 48, "2024-10-15"]],
            ["name", "KB", "modified"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # All rows should have separators at same positions
        separator_positions = {}
        for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
            positions = tuple(i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|")
            separator_positions[idx] = positions
        
        # Data rows (skip header and separator line)
        data_positions = [separator_positions[i] for i in [2, 3, 4]]
        
        # All data rows should have same separator positions
        for pos in data_positions[1:]:
            assert pos == data_positions[0], f"Row separators misaligned: {pos} vs {data_positions[0]}"

    def test_japanese_numbers_alignment(self):
        """Numbers with Japanese characters should align properly."""
        result = render(
            [["ファイルA", "123"],
             ["fileB", "1"]],
            ["名前", "数字"],
            align=["left", "right"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Numbers in second column should be right-aligned
        # Separators should be at same positions
        positions = []
        for line in lines[2:]:
            pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
            positions.append(pos)
        
        # All should have same separator positions
        for pos in positions[1:]:
            assert pos == positions[0]

    def test_all_japanese_columns(self):
        """All columns with Japanese characters should align."""
        result = render(
            [["ファイル", "日付"],
             ["レポート", "今日"]],
            ["名前", "時間"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Separators should align across all rows
        positions = []
        for line in lines[2:]:
            pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
            positions.append(pos)
        
        for pos in positions[1:]:
            assert pos == positions[0]

    def test_long_japanese_text_truncate(self):
        """Long Japanese text with truncation should work."""
        result = render(
            [["ファイルの名前が長いので切る必要がある"]],
            max_width=8
        )
        
        # Should contain truncation marker
        assert "…" in result
        # Should be a string
        assert isinstance(result, str)

    def test_japanese_with_different_alignments(self):
        """Different alignments should work with Japanese text."""
        for align_type in ["left", "right", "center"]:
            result = render(
                [["レポート"], ["file"]],
                align=align_type
            )
            assert isinstance(result, str)
            assert "レポート" in result
            assert "file" in result

    def test_zero_width_joining_characters(self):
        """Should handle complex unicode like combining marks."""
        result = render(
            [["café", "10"],
             ["file", "5"]],
            ["name", "size"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Separators should align
        positions = []
        for line in lines[2:]:
            pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
            positions.append(pos)
        
        for pos in positions[1:]:
            assert pos == positions[0]

    def test_mixed_width_columns(self):
        """Columns with mixed ASCII and Japanese widths should align."""
        result = render(
            [["a", "日本"],
             ["レポート", "b"]],
            ["col1", "col2"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Separators in all rows should align
        for i in range(len(lines)):
            assert isinstance(lines[i], str)

    def test_japanese_in_different_rows(self):
        """Japanese in different rows should not affect alignment."""
        result = render(
            [["a", "b", "c"],
             ["レ", "d", "e"],
             ["f", "g", "h"]],
            ["col1", "col2", "col3"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # All separators should align
        positions = []
        for line in lines[2:]:
            pos = tuple(i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|")
            positions.append(pos)
        
        for pos in positions[1:]:
            assert pos == positions[0]

    def test_japanese_respects_max_width_visual(self):
        """max_width should respect visual width, not character count."""
        # This tests that a Japanese string respects max_width in visual terms
        result = render(
            [["ファイル"]],
            max_width=5
        )
        # Should complete without error
        assert isinstance(result, str)
        # Should not contain unchecked assumptions about length
        assert len(result) >= 0

    def test_wrap_japanese_text(self):
        """Wrapping should work with Japanese text."""
        result = render(
            [["ファイル ファイル ファイル"]],
            max_width=4,
            wrap=True
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should wrap into multiple lines or fit in one
        assert len(lines) >= 1
        assert all(isinstance(line, str) for line in lines)

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestJapaneseBasicAlignment:
    """Test that columns line up correctly when cells contain Japanese characters."""

    def test_simple_japanese_alignment(self):
        """Single column with Japanese text should render without extra spacing."""
        result = render([["レポート"], ["notes"]])
        # Both lines should have the same visual width
        lines = result.split("\n")
        assert len(lines) == 2
        assert lines[0] == "レポート"
        assert lines[1] == "notes"

    def test_japanese_with_multiple_columns(self):
        """Columns should line up with Japanese characters in first column."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート_2024.pdf", 12, "2024-11-02"],
                ["notes.txt", 3, "2024-11-20"],
                ["議事録.docx", 48, "2024-10-15"],
            ],
            ["name", "KB", "modified"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Header line
        assert "name" in lines[0]
        assert "KB" in lines[0]
        assert "modified" in lines[0]
        # Separator should have matching column widths
        assert "|" in lines[1]
        # All data lines should have pipes at the same positions
        for line in lines[2:]:
            assert line.count("|") == 2

    def test_japanese_header_alignment(self):
        """Column headers and data should align when headers are Japanese."""
        result = render(
            [["a", "b"], ["短い", "longer"]],
            ["名前", "value"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify pipes are at consistent positions
        header_pipes = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        data_pipes = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[2]) if c == "|"]
        # Pipes should be at the same positions
        assert header_pipes == data_pipes

    def test_mixed_ascii_japanese_alignment(self):
        """Mixed ASCII and Japanese text should maintain column alignment."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["file.txt", "English"],
                ["ファイル.txt", "日本語"],
            ],
            ["filename", "language"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Count pipes to verify columns are consistent
        for line in lines:
            pipe_count = line.count("|")
            assert pipe_count == 1

class TestJapaneseColumnsLineUp:
    """Test the specific issue reported: columns should line up with Japanese names."""

    def test_reported_issue_basic(self):
        """Columns should line up with Japanese file names."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート_2024.pdf", 12],
                ["notes.txt", 3],
                ["議事録.docx", 48],
            ],
            ["name", "KB"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All lines should have pipe at same position
        pipes_positions = [line.index("|") for line in lines if "|" in line]
        # All should be at the same position
        assert len(set(pipes_positions)) == 1

    def test_reported_issue_full(self):
        """Full example from the issue: all columns should line up."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート_2024.pdf", 12, "2024-11-02"],
                ["notes.txt", 3, "2024-11-20"],
                ["議事録.docx", 48, "2024-10-15"],
            ],
            ["name", "KB", "modified"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Collect all pipe positions
        for col_num in [0, 1]:  # Two separators
            pipe_positions = []
            for line in lines:
                pipes = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
                if col_num < len(pipes):
                    pipe_positions.append(pipes[col_num])
            # All positions for same column should match
            if pipe_positions:
                assert len(set(pipe_positions)) == 1

    def test_visual_width_consistency(self):
        """Verify that lines with equal visual content have equal display length."""
        # Create a simple test with a known wide-character situation
        result = render(
            [["あいうえお"], ["abcdefgh"]],  # あいうえお is 5 chars, 10 display width
        )
        # Both should have same column width
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # The important thing is columns should align if displayed
        assert len(lines) == 2

"""Tests for proper handling of East Asian Width characters (Japanese, etc.)"""

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestBasicJapaneseAlignment:
    """Japanese text should align properly with correct display width calculation."""

    def test_simple_japanese_column(self):
        """A column with Japanese text should be sized by display width, not character count."""
        result = render([["レポート"], ["notes"]], ["name"])
        lines = result.split("\n")

        # First column should be sized for "レポート" (8 display width)
        # Japanese characters are 2 width each: レ(2) + ポ(2) + ー(2) + ト(2) = 8
        # "notes" is 5 width
        # So column should be 8 wide
        assert len(lines) == 3
        # Header line
        assert "name" in lines[0]
        # Separator should contain dashes (at least 8 for the column width)
        assert "-" in lines[1]
        # Data lines should align properly
        assert "レポート" in lines[2] or "レポート" in result

    def test_mixed_japanese_and_ascii_columns(self):
        """Columns with both Japanese and ASCII text should align correctly."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート_2024.pdf", "12"],
                ["notes.txt", "3"],
                ["議事録.docx", "48"]
            ],
            ["name", "KB"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")

        # Verify that the pipes align vertically
        # This means extracting the column positions of separators
        pipe_positions_header = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == '|']

        # All lines should have pipes at the same positions
        for line in lines[1:]:
            pipe_positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == '|']
            assert pipe_positions == pipe_positions_header, (
                f"Columns misaligned in line: {line!r}"
            )

    def test_japanese_with_different_widths(self):
        """Different Japanese names with varying display widths should align correctly."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート", "data1"],
                ["短", "data2"],
                ["非常に長い日本語のテキスト", "data3"]
            ],
            ["Name", "Value"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")

        # Verify all pipes align
        pipe_positions_header = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == '|']
        for line in lines[2:]:  # Skip separator
            pipe_positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == '|']
            assert pipe_positions == pipe_positions_header


class TestJapaneseTruncation:
    """Truncation with max_width should handle Japanese text correctly."""

    def test_truncate_japanese_text(self):
        """Truncating Japanese text should respect display width, not character count."""
        # "レポート" is 4 characters but 8 display width
        # With max_width=5, it should be truncated to fit in 5 display columns
        result = render([["レポート"]], max_width=5)

        # Should truncate to stay within 5 display width, leaving room for ellipsis
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Result should contain ellipsis and truncate the Japanese text
        assert "…" in result  # Should contain ellipsis
        # Should be much shorter than the original
        assert len(result) < 20

    def test_truncate_mixed_text(self):
        """Truncating text with both Japanese and ASCII should work correctly."""
        # "レポート_2024.pdf" mixed Japanese and ASCII
        result = render([["レポート_2024.pdf"]], max_width=10)

        # Should truncate and contain ellipsis
        assert "…" in result

    def test_ascii_still_works_with_max_width(self):
        """Ensure max_width still works correctly for ASCII text."""
        result = render([["abcdefghij"]], max_width=5)

        # Should truncate to 4 chars + ellipsis
        assert "…" in result
        # Result should be shorter than original
        assert len(result) < len("abcdefghij")


class TestJapaneseWrapping:

    def test_wrap_long_japanese_text(self):

            [["ああああああああああああああああ"]],
            max_width=10,
            wrap=True
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")

        # Should wrap into multiple lines
        assert len(lines) > 1
        # Result should contain the Japanese characters
        assert "あ" in result

    def test_wrap_mixed_text(self):

        result = render(
            [["hello world レポート test"]],
            max_width=12,
            wrap=True
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")

        # Should produce at least 2 lines (since input is longer than max_width)

        # Check pipes align in both cases
        for lines in [lines_a, lines_b]:

                pipe_pos_first = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
                for line in lines[1:]:
